overview_description.description:
At Gamefam our mission is to bring creator dreams come to life bigger and better with more fun through teamwork, collaboration and industry proven best practices.

Gamefam is a team of industry veterans and Roblox natives. With over 100 team members striving daily to achieve amazing results and create unforgettable experiences, we’re one of the largest studios to work directly on the Roblox platform.

Gamefam was established in 2019 by Joe Ferencz in Los Angeles, California.

product.name: Gamefam Games Portfolio
product.description: A portfolio of live-operated Roblox, Fortnite, and Minecraft games, including original and licensed experiences across simulation, tycoon, sports, role-playing, obstacle-course, and action genres.

product.name: Branded Roblox and Fortnite Experiences
product.description: Development of branded games, themed worlds, gameplay integrations, and interactive events on Roblox and Fortnite for entertainment, sports, consumer, and media brands.

product.name: 360° Amplification Programs
product.description: Integrated marketing programs that extend gaming activations through media investment, influencer partnerships, social media, public relations, and creator-led content.

product.name: Insights & Measurement Solutions
product.description: Data and measurement services for Roblox and Fortnite campaigns, covering reach, frequency, gameplay engagement, brand lift, custom studies, and marketing-funnel performance.

product.name: Gamefam Dev X
product.description: A business growth and development service for Roblox creators that combines funding, game design, monetization, licensing, marketing, legal strategy, and studio support.

product.name: Gamefam Creator Fund
product.description: A funding and advisory program for Roblox, Fortnite, and other UGC game creators, providing capital, design guidance, assets, monetization support, marketing, partnerships, analytics, and roadmaps.
